title: On Doing the whole job by hand
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：do　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 do 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the herder ① did the whole job by hand at once, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② does the whole job by hand in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ do the whole job by hand at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ done the whole job by hand before — a line in the ledger for December 1979 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Doing the whole job by hand at once, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ do the room before the guests came in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Do the room before the guests came at once and never mention it again.

By 1992 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ does the room before the guests came at once every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ did the whole job by hand again when nobody else would.

⑩ To do the whole job by hand, my mother said in 1997, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody does the whole job by hand in the rain again and somebody must do the whole job by hand at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 做（一般过去式 did the whole job by hand：1985 年牧人头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 做（一般现在 does the whole job by hand：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 做（不定式 to do the whole job by hand：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 做（过去完成时 had done the whole job by hand：1979 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 做（动名词 doing the whole job by hand 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 收拾（do the room before the guests came：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去收拾客人来前把屋子收拾好）
G. v. 收拾（do the room before the guests came：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 做（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 does the room before the guests came，而母亲又一次 did the whole job by hand）

answers.why: do 意为“做”，1985 年牧人二话不说地做一个人做完整件事，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 did。
do 意为“做”，自那以后牧人淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 does。
do 意为“做”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯做一个人做完整件事”，此处为不定式 to do the whole job by hand。
do 意为“做”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1992 年之前就有人做过，故用过去完成时 had done。
do 意为“做”，牧人说“做一个人做完整件事这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 doing the whole job by hand 作主语。
do 意为“收拾”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去收拾客人来前把屋子收拾好”，should ever 之后用原形 do the room before the guests came。
do 意为“收拾”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻收拾客人来前把屋子收拾好（do the room before the guests came at once），以后再也不要提起。
do 意为“做”，新来的邻人每个冬天都照例收拾客人来前把屋子收拾好，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 does。
do 意为“做”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地做一个人做完整件事，用一般过去式 did 叙述。
do 意为“做”，结尾那句是母亲 1997 年的话：要做一个人做完整件事，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 do 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the herder did the whole job by hand at once, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder does the whole job by hand in the rain whenever the pasture asks.
Doing the whole job by hand at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever do the room before the guests came in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture does the room before the guests came at once every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother did the whole job by hand again, and the pasture remembered that half.
